messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you sell your acoustic guitar quickly and safely: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a quick wash (soft cloth, mild cleaner) and tune it to standard pitch. | A well‑presented, in‑tune instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take Quality Photos** | Shoot from multiple angles (front, back, sides, headstock, sound hole, strings). Use natural light, avoid glare. | Good photos attract buyers and reduce questions. | | **3. Write a Clear Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, condition (e.g., “excellent, no cracks”), any upgrades (new strings, pickups), and why you’re selling. | Transparency builds trust and speeds up the sale. | | **4. Set a Competitive Price** | Research similar listings on eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local music shops. Price 10–20 % below the average if you want a quick sale. | Pricing too high stalls sales; pricing too low leaves money on the table. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform** | • **Online Marketplaces** – eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp.
• **Music‑Specific Sites** – Reverb, Guitar Center’s resale program.
• **Local Consignment Shops** – Many record stores or instrument shops will sell on your behalf for a commission.
• **Social Media Groups** – Local buy/sell groups, Reddit r/Guitar, Discord communities. | Different platforms reach different audiences; use a mix for maximum exposure. | | **6. Draft a Safe Transaction Plan** | • For local sales: meet in a public place (coffee shop, police station, or a store’s front desk).
• For shipping: use a sturdy box, bubble wrap, and trackable insurance. | Safety first—never hand over cash before receiving payment. | | **7. Handle Payment Securely** | • Cash or Venmo/PayPal for local deals.
• For shipping, request PayPal Goods & Services or a bank transfer. | Protect yourself from fraud. | | **8. Ship or Deliver** | If shipping, package the guitar with foam inserts, double‑box it, and ship via UPS Ground or USPS Priority Mail with tracking and insurance. | Proper packaging prevents damage and gives you proof of delivery. | | **9. Follow Up** | After the sale, confirm receipt, ask for a quick review if you used a marketplace, and keep a copy of the transaction details. | Good follow‑up can lead to referrals and repeat business. | ### Quick Tips - **Timing**: List during the week; people browse more often on weekdays. - **Negotiation**: Be prepared to negotiate but set a firm bottom line. - **Legal**: Keep a copy of the sale agreement and any receipts for tax purposes. - **Safety**: Never accept a check unless you verify it’s legitimate; consider using escrow services for high‑value items. ### Example Listing > **Title:** 2015 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition > **Description:** > *Brand:* Yamaha > *Model:* FG800 > *Year:* 2015 > *Serial:* 12345678 > *Condition:* Excellent – no scratches, no cracks, new strings installed. > *Why Selling:* Upgrading to a 12‑string. > *Price:* $350 (negotiable). > *Payment:* Cash or Venmo for local pickup; PayPal Goods & Services for shipping. > *Pickup:* Downtown coffee shop, 5 pm–9 pm. > *Shipping:* Available with tracking and insurance. Feel free to tweak the description to match your guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!
